name: Data Story
description: Numbers, trends, comparisons — anything where the data IS the story. A calm, editorial data explainer: deep ink background, one warm accent per idea, Archivo headlines, IBM Plex Mono numbers and labels, charts that draw themselves to scale, and the source always on screen.
best_use_cases: Data-driven explainers with sources on screen
style: Editorial data explainer: lines draw left to right with a glowing head, bars grow one by one with counting values, comparison cards with a sand multiplier, and a plain-language takeaway with a sand pill behind the key phrase.
